title: Registry Service Options Schema
description: Generates a plain (non-api) service class (*.service.ts) under src/app/shared/services.

name.description: The name for the new service.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the service?

project.description: The name of the project where the service should be added.

path.description: The path where the service file should be created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/shared/services.
